subject: FintechCorp - Security & IR discovery follow-up
summary: Post-call follow-up after discovery with FintechCorp security & procurement. Asked for SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, vendor questionnaire initiation, and evidence for incident response (IR) timelines and BCP/DR. Redwood to provide IR summary and complete vendor questionnaire; FintechCorp to share their completed questionnaire and confirm timeline for SOC 2 Type II report.
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Chris Langston <chris.langston@fintechcorp.com>, Anne Reyes <anne.reyes@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: FintechCorp - Security & IR discovery follow-up

Hi Chris / Anne —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap of the items we discussed and next steps so we stay aligned: 

- SOC 2: you mentioned FintechCorp requires SOC 2 Type II or equivalent evidence for vendors.
- GDPR / HIPAA: we discussed data residency and whether PHI is in scope (you said not at the moment, but will confirm).
- Incident response / breach notification: you asked for a runbook excerpt and SLA for notification timelines and BCP/DR evidence.
- Vendor questionnaire: you said you would share your vendor security questionnaire for us to complete.

Actions / owners:
1) Jordan (me): I will send a short IR summary and an extract of our runbook, plus complete your vendor questionnaire within 3 business days. I will also surface any SOC 2 evidence we can share now (Type I / bridge letters) while Type II is in progress. Attachment: postcall-notes.pdf (call notes + proposed MAM).
2) Chris: please share the vendor security questionnaire and confirm the target timeline for SOC 2 Type II (you mentioned ~2-4 weeks for final availability).
3) Anne: confirm procurement timeline and whether DocuSign or Ariba is required for the PO/contract.
4) Marissa: can you confirm which BCP/DR artifacts we can share (high-level runbook, DR test summary)?

Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync next week to review the completed questionnaire and any evidence we upload (I suggested Tue/Wed).

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.com]

Attachment: postcall-notes.pdf (1 page)

From: Chris Langston <chris.langston@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Anne Reyes <anne.reyes@fintechcorp.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCorp - Security & IR discovery follow-up

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap and notes. A few quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: we're currently finalizing our Type II audit. Expected availability of the full report is in ~3 weeks, but we can provide a bridge letter and SOC 2 Type I artifacts sooner if useful.
- GDPR / HIPAA: PHI is not in scope for this engagement today — we will confirm in writing but that is our current stance.
- Incident response / breach notification: Our security policy requires vendor notification within 72 hours of confirmed data breach discovery; our procurement team will need documented notification timelines and evidence of your IR processes.
- Vendor questionnaire: attaching our vendor questionnaire (Fintech_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx). Please fill and return; highlight any questions you want to discuss.

We can target a follow-up on Tuesday 2027-04-13 at 10:00 PT if that works for you.

Best,
Chris Langston
Head of Security | FintechCorp
chris.langston@fintechcorp.com

Attachment: Fintech_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Chris Langston <chris.langston@fintechcorp.com>, Anne Reyes <anne.reyes@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCorp - Security & IR discovery follow-up

Chris / Anne —

Appreciate the quick reply and the questionnaire. Confirming next steps from Redwood: 

- We will complete the questionnaire and return it by end-of-day 2027-04-14 (within 3 business days).
- I am attaching a short IR summary (redwood_ir_summary.pdf) with our contact list, escalation paths, and our standard notification SLA (we target <24 hours to acknowledge, full investigation timeline varies).
- Marissa will follow up with available BCP/DR artifacts (DR test summary, recovery RPO/RTO high-level numbers).

We are good for Tue 2027-04-13 at 10:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite. If anything is time-sensitive (e.g., formal procurements), Anne please flag and we'll prioritize packaging the artifacts.

On the SOC 2 timeline: we will share any available bridge letters or Type I evidence right away; Type II will be provided when completed.

Thanks —
Jordan

Attachment: redwood_ir_summary.pdf
